description: Defines data structures and constants related to WLAN channel scan configuration parameters for the dwpal driver within the bwl namespace.

classes.name: sScanCfgParams
classes.description: Structure holding parameters for channel scan driver configuration, including dwell times, probe requests, and intervals.

classes.name: sScanCfgParamsBG_legacy
classes.description: Legacy background scan configuration parameters with dwell times, probe requests, chunk size, break times, and busy flag.

classes.name: sScanCfgParamsBG
classes.description: Extended background scan configuration structure inheriting legacy parameters and adding window slices and cts-to-self duration.
